procedure.title: ansible ローカル6ホスト検証手順

steps.title: 全6ホストの疎通確認
steps.command: ansible all -i samples/local_test/inventory.ini -e '{"INVENTORY": "samples/local_test/inventory.ini", "CHECK_LABEL": "定期点検"}' -m shell -a 'echo "host=$(hostname) user=$(id -un)"'
steps.criteria:
rc == 0 and
out("web01 \| CHANGED") and out("web02 \| CHANGED") and out("web03 \| CHANGED") and
out("db01 \| CHANGED") and out("db02 \| CHANGED") and out("mon01 \| CHANGED") and
not out("UNREACHABLE|FAILED")

steps.title: webservers グループのみ負荷確認
steps.command: ansible webservers -i samples/local_test/inventory.ini -e '{"INVENTORY": "samples/local_test/inventory.ini", "CHECK_LABEL": "定期点検"}' -f 6 -m shell -a uptime
steps.criteria:
rc == 0 and
out("web01") and out("web02") and out("web03") and
not out("db01|db02|mon01") and
not out("UNREACHABLE|FAILED")
